name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Row the bar to your lower chest, driving the elbows back.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control. A foundational back thickness builder.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: An intermediate barbell pull-pattern exercise for the lats. Barbell Row strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
